title: Shopify Singapore (2026): availability, payment gateways, PayNow and fees
summary: Is Shopify available in Singapore? Yes. How Shopify Payments, PayNow and HitPay fit together, what HitPay charges on Shopify and how to set it up.
body_markdown:
Updated 17 Nov 2026


## Is Shopify available in Singapore?


Yes. You can open a Shopify store in Singapore, and Singapore is on Shopify’s list of Shopify Payments countries, so you can take cards through Shopify itself. What Shopify doesn’t add natively is PayNow, which many Singapore shoppers pay with from their bank app. Singapore stores that want PayNow add a local payment app next to Shopify Payments. HitPay adds PayNow, GrabPay, ShopeePay, cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay to the same checkout. Refunds started in Shopify admin sync to HitPay. Online and in-store sales land in one HitPay dashboard and one payout.


## What Shopify costs in Singapore


Shopify’s plan prices for Singapore are on[shopify.com/sg/pricing](https://www.shopify.com/sg/pricing) . If you use a third-party payment provider instead of Shopify Payments, Shopify can charge its own third-party transaction fee depending on your plan, so check your plan.


Shopify’s Singapore pricing page lists the third-party transaction fee as 2% on Basic, 1% on Grow, 0.6% on Advanced and 0.2% on Plus (checked 17 Nov 2026).


## Payment options for Shopify in Singapore


-


Shopify Payments (cards)


-


[PayNow](https://hitpayapp.com/sg/paynow) through a payment app


-


GrabPay and ShopeePay


-


BNPL


HitPay adds PayNow, GrabPay, ShopeePay, cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay and BNPL through[one Shopify app](https://hitpayapp.com/sg/shopify) .

Worked example: on a S$100 PayNow order, HitPay’s fee is 0.65% + S$0.30 (S$0.95) plus 0.5% for the Shopify app (S$0.50), so S$1.45 in total. On a S$40 order, it’s 0.9% (S$0.36) plus 0.5% (S$0.20), so S$0.56.


## Where HitPay is and isn’t the cheapest


HitPay adds 0.5% on Shopify orders, so for a store that only sells cards online through Shopify, Shopify Payments alone may cost less. HitPay makes the most sense when you need PayNow at checkout, or also sell in store, by payment link or by invoice, all from one account.


## Shopify POS in Singapore


The HitPay Terminal app (in beta) sends each Shopify POS sale to a HitPay FlexiPOS or All-in-One terminal, where the customer pays by card or PayNow QR, and the order is marked paid in Shopify. Register with the form, install from the link HitPay sends, and make sure your Shopify store currency is SGD.


## How to set up HitPay on Shopify


1.


**Create a HitPay account.** Sign up free and complete business verification.


2.


**Install the app.** Search “[HitPay Payment Gateway](https://apps.shopify.com/hitpay-payment-gateway) ” in the Shopify App Store (apps.shopify.com/hitpay-payment-gateway) and install it.


3.


**Connect.** Log in to HitPay from the app to link your store.


4.


**Choose methods.** In HitPay go to Integrations → Shopify and turn on PayNow, cards, GrabPay and ShopeePay.


5.


**Test.** Turn on test mode in the app and place a test order.


6.


**Go live.** Turn test mode off. PayNow now shows at checkout.


## FAQ


### Is Shopify available in Singapore?


Yes. Shopify is available in Singapore, and Shopify Payments supports Singapore stores for cards. PayNow isn’t built into Shopify, so stores add it with an app such as HitPay.


### Does Shopify Payments work in Singapore?


Yes. Shopify Payments is available in Singapore, and HitPay runs alongside it as an additional payment method for PayNow and other local methods. Shopify may charge its own third-party gateway fee depending on your plan, so check your Shopify plan.


### Does Shopify support PayNow?


Shopify does not natively support PayNow, but you can enable PayNow payments using HitPay’s Shopify payment gateway integration.


### How much does HitPay charge on Shopify in Singapore?


PayNow is 0.65% + S$0.30 on payments of S$100 and above, or 0.9% (min S$0.20) below S$100, plus 0.5% for the Shopify app. No setup or monthly fee.


### How fast are payouts?


Card payouts arrive T+1 business days and non-card payouts, including PayNow, T+1 calendar day.


### Can I refund a PayNow order from Shopify admin?


Yes. Refunds started from the Shopify order sync to HitPay and go back to the customer, as long as the payment method supports refunds. If you refund from the HitPay dashboard instead, mark the order refunded in Shopify yourself, because HitPay-side refunds don’t update the Shopify order.
